violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Fried plantains (109F) and fried rice (126F) observed in front steam well.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated items were cooked ~1hr prior and will be discarded within the next two hours.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: House mayo (69F) in squirt bottle and pork sauce (52F) in squirt bottle observed in ice well near cookline. Portioned house mayo (65F) and portioned pepper sauce (60F) observed in ice well at front service counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS instructed employee to add more ice as it has melted to ensure food items stay cold. Portions of sauces placed directly in contact with ice to cool.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP tilapia in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: EHS instructed employee to cut open tilapia packages when moving from freezer to cooler unit to defrost. QATA (Inspection Date: 05/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP tilapia in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: EHS instructed employee to cut open tilapia packages when moving from freezer to cooler unit to defrost.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs observed stored over RTE vegetables in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Employee to rearrange walk in cooler to have eggs on bottom shelving.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked beef (125F) observed in steam table.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated item will be remade for dinner service.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: roasted vegetable salsa sauce (67F) observed in well with melted ice. Crumbled feta (50F) observed in cold rail.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Ice replenished to cool sauce. Feta to be discarded.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Cooked chicken (52F) observed in 1 Dr 2 Draw prep, PIC stated chicken was cooked the day prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Chicken discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poisonous or Toxic Material
violations.observation: A container previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials (DISH SOAP) is being used to store COLESLAW IN WALK IN.
violations.corrective_action: Do not store food in containers previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials. This practice may result in food contamination and subsequent medical consequences to anyone consuming the contaminated food. Food discarded, discussed container usage with PIC.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP Tilapia thawed in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: EHS instructed employee to cut out tilapia from ROP packaging before thawing in walk in cooler. QATA (Inspection Date: 05/22/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops observed in container of ambient water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Scoops taken to wash and returned in plain container.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the dish and cook line is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. Yuca ~5hrs 79F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded.
